parts.label: Boiler
parts.note: Heat turns high-pressure water into superheated steam

parts.label: Furnace (heat in)
parts.note: Burning fuel supplies the heat Q in

parts.label: High-pressure steam
parts.note: Hot, high-pressure steam goes to the turbine

parts.label: Turbine
parts.note: Steam expands and does work turning the shaft

parts.label: Generator
parts.note: The turbine turns it to make electricity

parts.label: Condenser
parts.note: Cools exhaust steam back to water (Q out)

parts.label: Feed pump
parts.note: Pushes the water back up to boiler pressure
